notes:
Use-case: customer support chat agents for a B2B SaaS product (billing + troubleshooting triage). Evaluating Hosted API first; Dedicated as follow-on for burst predictability and data isolation. Primary constraint: streaming required and strict first-token SLO (<1.5s). Team cares about tool-calling to surface account data (internal CRM + billing lookup) in responses.

Key quotes and shorthand from calls:
- VP Product: "If the bot slows at peak, CS queues spike — unacceptable. We need consistent <1.5s first token, ideally ~1s median."
- Head of Platform: "We prefer hosted for speed to market; will move to Dedicated once SLA + pricing match our runway."

POC notes / findings to date:
- 2026-02-18 demo (ff call id above): Redwood streaming demo shows median first-token ~0.9s; 95th ~1.6s on our test trace (with 8 concurrent agents simulated). Good start but 95th misses target.
- 2026-03-02 engineering deep-dive with Marcus: walked through tool-calling patterns (CRM calls, invoice lookup, attachable actions). Concern: per-request auth to KMS for PII retrieval; asked for doc on KMS integration + token redaction.
- Security questionnaire submitted 2026-02-25; answered most SOC2/KMS items, pending legal on data residency clause.
- Cost sensitivity: daily active chats ~3k; expected token volume 7-12M tokens/mo in steady state; want clear unit economics and batching/kv-cache suggestions.

Technical asks / acceptance criteria:
- Streaming + function/tool calling + structured output (JSON actions) must be stable under burst.
- First-token SLO: target 1.5s (hard), preferred median <1.1s, 95th <1.5s for hosted POC traffic profile.
- Fallback plan: auto-route to smaller model or cached reply if latency spike detected. Need demonstration of graceful degradation.
- Telemetry: token-level latency breakdown, per-route traces, and cost-per-conversation reporting for finance.

Commercial / procurement notes:
- Interested in 12-month commit for Dedicated if baseline SLA demonstrated. ARR expectation $60k-$120k. Pricing call scheduled.
- Competitive checks: testing OpenAI streaming and Anthropic; Redwood beat on batch throughput in internal benchmark but want more hard numbers on SLO at high concurrency.

Next steps (short):
- Redwood to run 72h POC (hosted) using Skyward traffic replay; include streaming + tool calls + SLO telemetry (Marcus/SE scope).
- Security: provide KMS integration guide + reference SOC2 artifacts (Priya triaging).
- Commercial: deliver draft Dedicated SOW + pricing anchor after POC (Ava leading).

CRM shorthand: demo-good, POC-scheduled, legal-touchpoint, cost-will-drive commit, "SLO or bust" sentiment from VP.
